scripts.build: bun build src/client/main.ts src/client/admin.ts --outdir public/assets --target browser --minify
scripts.dev: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply purplelittleguy --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply purplelittleguy --remote && wrangler deploy && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.www.jsonc
scripts.serve: bun run build && bun run scripts/serve.ts
